topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent Line-of-Sight (LOS) connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations, adaptive beamforming strategies that can efficiently manage interference and spatial non-stationarity are essential. Employing multi-user MIMO beamforming, hybrid beamforming, compressive sensing, efficient signal processing algorithms, and adaptive modulation and coding can help balance capacity, reliability, and complexity in A2A communication systems. Furthermore, artificial intelligence and machine learning can be leveraged to optimize these strategies and improve the performance of A2A communication systems.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the challenges of maintaining reliable connectivity in A2A communication systems due to high-velocity aircraft and unpredictable mobility patterns. It emphasizes the importance of accurate channel modeling, system-level performance evaluation, and practical implementation for Extremely Large Aperture Antennas (ELAA) in A2A communication systems.
